Package com.j3d.ui.engine.floating.properties.panels

Interface PropertyPanel<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type that the properties all hold.
All Known Implementing Classes:
BooleanProperty, ColourProperty, IDProperty, IntProperty, ObjectProperty, StringProperty, Vector3Property
public interface PropertyPanel<T>
PropertyPanel is the interface which defines how a PropertyEntry's sub panel displays and edits components.

This interface exists such as to allow all sub panels to access the entire list of Property associated with it.

The following classes implement this interface: BooleanProperty, ColourProperty, IDProperty, IntProperty, ObjectProperty, StringProperty, Vector3Property

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

      default ArrayList<Property<T,?>> typeConvert(ArrayList<Property<?,?>> properties)
      Converts a list of generic properties to a list of properties of the specific type T. This method assumes that all properties in the input list are indeed of type T.

      default String getActionDesc(String type, Object val)
      Generates a description for an action based on whether it's a single or batch edit, the type of property, and the new value.

    • runAndAddAction

      default void runAndAddAction(T value, String type)
      Executes an action that modifies the properties and adds it to the history for undo/redo functionality. This method handles both single and batch property edits.
      Parameters:
      value - The new value to be set for the properties.
      type - The type of the property being edited (e.g., "Int", "String").
